columns.name: num_poor_performing_employees
columns.description: Number of poor performing employees in the position, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_female_employees
columns.description: Number of female employees in the position, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: per_salary_over_20000
columns.description: Percentage of employees with a salary over $20,000 a year in the position

columns.name: avg_salary
columns.description: Average salary of employees in the position

columns.name: has_maximum_salary_no_more_than_70000
columns.description: Set to 1 if the maximum salary for the position is no more than $70,000, otherwise, set to 0

columns.name: location_address
columns.description: The detailed address of the location

columns.name: num_employees
columns.description: Number of employees at the location, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: highest_paid_employee
columns.description: The full name of the highest paid employee at the location, with ties broken by ascending order of the employee's last name. The full name concatenates the first name and last name with a space separating them.

columns.name: num_of_trainee
columns.description: The number of employees who are Trainees work at the location, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_Account_Representatives_with_Average_performance
columns.description: The number of Account Representatives with 'Average' performance at the location, replace NULL values with 0.

columns.name: num_employees_have_good_perfomance
columns.description: The number of employees who have 'Good' joob performance at the location, replace NULL values with 0.
